verdict.rationale: Bolna's own call-history view documents performance metrics, recordings, transcripts and raw execution data for debugging, which gives post-call production monitoring. Nothing in the evidence shows real-time monitoring of in-progress calls or any alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. Missing for 10: live/real-time call monitoring, alerting or threshold-based notifications on errors or misbehavior, error-rate dashboards, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike

citations.quote: View performance metrics, listen to recordings, read transcripts, and access raw execution data for debugging and analysis.
Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI. Push data to your CRM from every call.
